method: top-20 CA ptype=1 basic_people targets located by trailing identity, then factory + slot19 Unicorn decode

verification.locating_predicate: identity <III>(ordinal,uid,uid), prior header <IB>(ordinal,1), 0<body_len<=2600, Unicorn bytes_consumed-12 == identity_pos-hit-5
verification.people_db_header: u16 optional-tagged-field count; count * 3 bytes; then five i16 values (home/current/world reputation, CA, PA)
verification.attributes: every mapped scalar attribute decoded from row-specific Unicorn wire positions and checked in 0..20
